plan: Given my private value of $46, I aim to maximize profit by balancing the bid to win probability and profit margin. Bidding exactly $46 maximizes my profit if I win, but risks losing if others bid slightly higher. To increase winning chances while retaining profit, I'll bid slightly below my value at $45. This bid is competitive against others who might undervalue their bids, yet it maintains a $1 profit margin.
